_comment: Default 'greeting' play-mode sequence (plan §5, Phase 4). Loaded by PlayModeManager on POST /api/playmodes/greeting/activate. Each keyframe is a partial EyeCommand: panDeg/tiltDeg (degrees, ±45 working range) and lidUpperL/lidLowerL/lidUpperR/lidLowerR (normalized 0=closed..1=open) are all optional — omit a field to leave that axis alone. durationMs is required; easing is 'linear' or 'easeInOut' (default if omitted). Story: wake up (eyes closed, looking down) -> open partway -> look at viewer -> wide-eyed surprise -> settle to idle's resting baseline.
